Purpose: The database handles rental of bikes, electric scooters, safety equipment, skates, boards, and water sport equipment.
Main relationship: Equipment -> Inventory -> RentalLines -> Rental_transaction -> Customer.
Station relationship: Rental_transaction uses rental_station_id and return_station_id to show pickup and return stations.
Employee relationship: Employees work at Rental_station through station_id. Rental_station.employee_id can represent responsible employee/manager.
Business rule: One customer can have many rental transactions, and one rental transaction can contain many rental lines.
Business rule: Inventory status should show Available, Rented, or Maintenance.
